assignments.title: Quadratic Equations & Optimization Problems
assignments.description: Solve exercises 4.1 to 4.3 from textbook. Show all derivation steps for the quadratic roots and vertex calculations.

assignments.title: Electromagnetic Induction Lab Analysis
assignments.description: Write an experimental review on Faraday’s Law and Lenz’s Law with labeled schematic diagrams of magnetic flux.

assignments.title: Critical Essay on Shakespearean Tragic Flaw
assignments.description: Compose a 1200-word analytical essay discussing the hubris in Macbeth Act III.

assignments.title: Python Binary Search & Complexity Lab
assignments.description: Implement iterative and recursive binary search in Python with big-O notation complexity graphs.

submissions.content: Attached Python script with recursive and iterative implementations along with benchmark timings.
submissions.feedback: Excellent code hygiene, robust edge case handling, and well-documented docstrings.

submissions.content: Solutions to all 12 exercises with handwritten derivation scans attached.

notices.title: Midterm Examinations 2026 Official Date Sheet & Instructions
notices.content: All students and faculty members are informed that Midterm Examinations will commence from the scheduled dates. Morning sessions begin strictly at 08:30 AM. Clear transparent pencil cases and official student ID cards are mandatory in the examination hall.

notices.title: Annual Science Olympiad & Robotics Exhibition Registration
notices.content: Registration is now open for the 7th Aurelian Science & Robotics Exhibition. Categories include AI & Automation, Green Energy Prototypes, and Mathematical Modelling. Interested teams should submit their project abstracts by Friday.

notices.title: Class 10 Advanced Physics Practical Lab Schedule
notices.content: Section A & B students of Class 10 must complete their optical bench and projectile trajectory practical logbooks before Thursday.

notices.title: Winter Uniform Transition Period Notice
notices.content: Commencing Monday, students are permitted to transition into the official navy blue blazer and school cardigan. Standard institutional dress codes remain strictly enforced.

events.title: All-Pakistan Inter-School Debate Championship
events.description: Parliamentary style debate in English & Urdu hosted at the Jinnah Memorial Auditorium.

events.title: Annual Parent-Teacher Conference (PTM Term 1)
events.description: One-on-one evaluations with class and subject teachers regarding progress and midterm results.

events.title: Iqbal Day Commemoration & Poetry Recital
events.description: Institutional celebration of the philosophy of Allama Iqbal with declamation contests.

events.title: Annual Sports Gala 2026
events.description: Track and field athletics, cricket finals, football tournament, and tug-of-war.
